CHUPACABRA

“Evolution, but impatient.”

Core Identity

Predatory survivors shaped by collapse, mutation, and weaponized adaptation. You are not a species that thrived—you are one that refused to die.

System Fit

High Violence synergy (combat-focused faction actions and raid options)

Resistant to Darkness (the corruption pressure that builds as reality destabilizes), but prone to overindulgence (you can survive the rot so well that you start leaning into it)

Thrive in Wasteland and Ruined hexes (damaged regions on the world map with fewer comforts and more danger)

Strong in Assault (direct attack operations) and Infiltration (stealth, sabotage, and getting where you should not be)

Political Drift Tendencies

Often pulled between:

Authoritarian — “Control the food chain.”

Anarchist — “Only the strong deserve to survive.”

Play This If You Like

Feral antiheroes

Moral ambiguity under pressure (system stress that forces hard tradeoffs and ugly choices)

Being the reason something went wrong at night

Mal Says

“You are what happens when extinction refuses.”

CIRCUITBORN

“You are not artificial. You are iterative.”

Core Identity

Synthetic lineage. Built, found, grown, or remembered into existence. You are not “a machine”—you are a process that did not stop.

Lines

Exo-Knight — War chassis, oath-bound purpose

Parallax — Multi-phase perception and timeline bleed (you perceive more than one version of events at once)

Salvage — Scrap-assembled identity

Synapse — Distributed consciousness mesh (a mind spread across linked parts, bodies, or systems)

System Fit

Strong Logistics and Economy synergy (supply, transport, production, and resource management)

Deep Rig Combat integration (fighting with or alongside faction vehicles and war machines)

Reduced Morale volatility (your faction’s overall emotional stability is less likely to swing wildly around you)

Vulnerable to Void-Signal Collapse (a breakdown in coordination, commands, or system control during operations)

Political Drift

Naturally compatible with Authoritarian systems (order, structure, and control often make intuitive sense to Circuitborn)

Synapse types often trend Libertarian, especially when collective identity starts colliding with personal autonomy

Play This If You Like

Tactical clarity and optimization

Being infrastructure with a personality

Exploring identity beyond biology

Mal Says

“The soul is not limited to carbon.”

ECHO-DIVER

“You remember things that haven’t happened yet.”

Core Identity

Leyline-sensitive beings who phase between present reality and memory strata. You are not lost—you are misaligned with time.

System Fit

Strong Travel synergy (movement across the world map, route play, and dangerous journeys)

Enhanced Gate interaction (better affinity with reality-bridges, fast-travel pathways, and strange passages)

High Ritual precision (structured acts that alter reality through power, alignment, and circumstance)

High sensitivity to Darkness fluctuations (you tend to feel corruption shifts before other people do)

Political Drift

Ideologically unstable

Your drift tends to follow lived experience rather than doctrine. What happens to you matters more than what you claim to believe.

Play This If You Like

Being metaphysically strange

Seeing what others cannot

Solving problems before they occur

Mal Says

“You are already somewhere else.”

FURRYKIN

“Evolution decided aesthetic was optional.”

Core Identity

Hybridized species engineered or uplifted through lost Eden projects. Instinct and intelligence coexist—and occasionally argue.

Variants

Felid — Agile predators

Leporid — Hyper-aware scouts

Mustelid — Tactical infiltrators

Ursid — Defensive anchors

Vulpin — Social manipulators

System Fit

Strong Infiltration synergy (sneaking, scouting, sabotage, and social misdirection)

High Morale interaction effects (you often influence the emotional temperature of the group around you)

Can help stabilize Hex Loyalty (how committed a region’s population is to your faction) through presence, trust, and social connection

Political Drift

Often trends Social Democratic (community-first, cooperative survival)

Or Anarchist (tribal autonomy, mutual support, minimal hierarchy)

Play This If You Like

Expressive physicality

Identity through instinct and culture

Fast, clever, or socially dangerous builds

Mal Says

“You are proof that nature experiments.”

MENHIRKIN

“You are older than cities.”

Core Identity

Stone-blooded beings bound to the geometry of the world. You are not in the territory—you are the territory remembering itself.

System Fit

Exceptional Hex defense (holding and protecting territory on the world map)

Boost Integration and Development stability (making a hex more secure, functional, and fully brought under faction control)

Resistant to Darkness effects (corruption has a harder time moving you)

Low mobility, high positional impact (you are strongest when planted exactly where you mean to be)

Political Drift

Extremely stable

Drift usually happens only after violence, repeated displacement, or sustained disruption

Play This If You Like

Holding the line

Being immovable

Turning geography into a weapon

Mal Says

“You are infrastructure.”

HUMAN

“Humanity was never singular.”

Core Identity

A fragmented lineage of survivors, each adapted to different extremes. Humans are not default—they are divergent baselines.

Lineages

Denisovan — Endurance and extreme environments

Erectus — Foundational resilience

Florensis — Compact ingenuity

Neanderthal — Direct, brutal survival

System Fit

Balanced across all systems

High adaptability

Politically volatile (humans respond quickly to faction culture, crisis, and opportunity)

Political Drift

Highly reactive to faction conditions

Humans can stabilize almost any ideology—or make it dramatically worse

Play This If You Like

Versatility

Being underestimated

Defining your own role in a strange world

Mal Says

“You think you are default. That is adorable.”

JACKALOPE

“Prey learned to lie.”

Core Identity

Small, fast, and deeply deceptive. Jackalopes survive not by strength, but by rewriting the expectations of those hunting them.

System Fit

High Perception (Mind) (Mind) and Stealth (Intrigue) (Intrigue) (Presence) synergy (spotting trouble early and misleading people effectively)

Strong in Infiltration (sneaking, sabotage, covert work) and Courtly play (social maneuvering, influence, favors, and political games)

Excellent for Shadowjack and intrigue-focused builds (characters built around stealth, trickery, and information advantage)

Political Drift

Often trends Libertarian or Anarchist survival models

Rigid hierarchy tends to feel like a trap, and Jackalopes are very good at slipping traps

Play This If You Like

Outsmarting stronger enemies

Trickster archetypes

Winning fights you should lose

Mal Says

“You are only prey if they understand you.”

OLDENBORN

“You were born aligned.”

Core Identity

Beings shaped directly by Sephirotic forces (the fractured divine structure underlying reality). You are not neutral. You are biased by creation itself.

Variants & Alignment

Earthbound — Malkuth (reality, grounding, material existence)

Ember-Touched — Gevurah (judgment, force, severity)

Lumenwrought — Tiferet (balance, harmony, radiant center)

Sky-Threaded — Chokmah (insight, inspiration, first creation)

Tideborne — Chesed (mercy, expansion, generous flow)

System Fit

Strong Ritual synergy (you work well with structured reality-shaping actions)

High Alignment resonance effects (your spiritual lean affects how powers, choices, and systems respond to you)

Core participants in Tikkun arcs (the long-term work of repairing the broken world)

Political Drift

Your alignment often conflicts with faction ideology

Internal tension is common. What you are and what your faction becomes may not always agree.

Play This If You Like

Playing ideology as identity

Divine influence mechanics

Being pulled in multiple directions

Mal Says

“You are born leaning toward the Tree.”

QLIPH-SCARRED

“You survived corruption.”

Core Identity

Touched by the inverse of the Tree—the broken, consuming echoes of creation. You are what happens when something goes wrong and keeps going anyway.

System Fit

Resistant to Darkness accumulation (you can withstand corruption better than most, though that does not make it safe)

Strong synergy with corruption-based Rituals and maneuvers (special tactical actions used during raids)

High risk, high reward interactions (you often get power by standing closer to disaster than anyone else should)

Political Drift

Frequently unstable

Can skew toward Authoritarian control (contain the chaos by force) or nihilistic Anarchism (if the world is broken, why pretend otherwise?)

Play This If You Like

Dangerous power

Walking the edge of collapse

Weaponizing corruption

Mal Says

“You didn’t escape. You adapted.”

RUSTLANDER SCAVENGER

“Entropy is a toolbox.”

Core Identity

Survivors of industrial collapse who learned to turn decay into advantage. Nothing is broken—only unclaimed potential.

System Fit

Strong Logistics and salvage-economy synergy (moving, repairing, reclaiming, and repurposing resources)

Excels in Blockade (choking off enemy movement or supply) and industrial operations (anything involving scrap, machines, or broken infrastructure)

Converts scarcity into function (you are good at making useful things out of almost nothing)

Political Drift

Often trends Pragmatic Authoritarian (resource control feels like survival)

Or Libertarian scavenger networks (loosely organized trade, salvage, and mutual advantage)

Play This If You Like

Building from nothing

Resource optimization

Turning trash into victory

Mal Says

“You see waste. They see a future.”

SEPHIROTIC SCION

“You are living alignment.”

Core Identity

Direct embodiments of Sephirotic forces. You are not influenced by alignment—you are an expression of it.

System Fit

Extremely high Ritual synergy (your nature already resonates with reality-shaping structures)

Strong interaction with Leylines (hidden flows of power running through the world) and Tikkun systems (the larger effort to repair what was broken)

Powerful, but fragile to misalignment (when you act against your nature, the consequences hit harder)

Political Drift

Highly vulnerable to ideological conflict

Misalignment causes severe internal instability (your identity and your faction’s direction can grind against each other hard enough to hurt)

Play This If You Like

Playing a living concept

High power with high narrative consequence

Alignment-driven gameplay

Mal Says

“You are not choosing a path. You are the path.”

STORMBORN NOMAD

“You do not belong to maps.”

Core Identity

Wanderers tied to movement, storms, and shifting boundaries. You are not rooted—you are momentum given form.

System Fit

Strong Travel system synergy (journeys, route play, mobility, and surviving the road)

High mobility, low anchoring (excellent at moving; less naturally suited to staying put)

Reduced effectiveness in Integration-focused play (bringing a hex fully under faction control is usually not your favorite problem)

Political Drift

Often trends Libertarian or Anarchist

Structured authority tends to feel less like safety and more like a cage

Play This If You Like

Constant motion

Exploration-first gameplay

Refusing to stay in one place

Mal Says

“You cannot hold lightning. Stop trying.”

🧭 ANCESTRY META SUMMARY

Ancestry TypeSystem Bias
CorruptedDarkness tradeoffs (more risk, more dangerous power)
AlignedRitual and Tikkun synergy (better connection to divine or reality-repair systems)
SyntheticLogistics and Rig integration (strong with systems, machines, and faction infrastructure)
NomadicTravel and mobility (excellent at movement, weaker at staying settled)
PredatoryAssault and pressure (good at aggression, fear, and momentum)
SocialCourtly and Morale systems (good at influence, relationships, and group stability)

CHARACTER ARCHETYPES (ARCANA EXPRESSION SYSTEM)

“Identity is a weapon. Now you know what kind you are.”

What Archetypes Do

Archetypes shape:

  • How you approach Raids (structured conflict systems using maneuvers and OP resources)

  • How you influence Political Drift (how your faction’s ideology evolves under pressure)

  • How you interact with Unity (cohesion) and Darkness (corruption pressure)

  • What kind of leadership pressure (expectations, consequences, identity weight) you create

They are not subclasses.

They are expressions of power under pressure—
the version of yourself that emerges when the world stops being fair.

THE MOON (ANCIENT BLOOD)

“You were never alone in your body.”

Core Identity

You carry inheritance with gravity.
Memory moves through you—sometimes older than history.

System Bias

  • Strong Ritual amplification

  • High Spark resonance

  • Sephirotic interactions are intensified

  • Vulnerable to Darkness spikes

Political Drift

  • High pressure when identity is denied or weaponized

  • Minority pressure escalates quickly

Raid Style

  • Symbolic escalation

  • High commitment plays

  • Ritual anchoring

Play This If You Like

  • Legacy tension

  • Identity burden

  • Mythic consequences

Mal Says

“You are not haunted. You are occupied.”

THE HIEROPHANT

“Belief becomes infrastructure.”

Core Identity

You organize meaning into systems that hold people together.

System Bias

  • Strong Faith OP

  • Darkness resistance

  • Ritual stability

  • Courtly leverage

Political Drift

  • Stable under integrity

  • Catastrophic under hypocrisy

Raid Style

  • Unity-driven

  • Ritual reinforcement

  • Corruption suppression

Play This If You Like

  • Leading through conviction

  • Moral weight

  • Institutional power

Mal Says

“They don’t follow you. They follow what you make them believe you are.”

THE EMPEROR (ADMINISTRATOR)

“Order is maintenance.”

Core Identity

You make systems survive reality.

System Bias

  • Economy OP generation

  • Logistics optimization

  • Hex development bonuses

  • Overextension mitigation

Political Drift

  • Stable under structured ideologies

  • Strains under chaos and violence

Raid Style

  • Defensive excellence

  • Strategic endurance

  • Infrastructure sustain

Play This If You Like

  • System mastery

  • Quiet power

  • Winning over time

Mal Says

“You don’t win fights. You make sure they can be fought.”

THE MAGICIAN (SCHOLAR)

“Understanding is leverage.”

Core Identity

You weaponize knowledge before conflict begins.

System Bias

  • Intrigue dominance

  • Espionage & Courtly superiority

  • Foresight systems

  • Encounter manipulation

Political Drift

  • Resistant to anti-truth systems

  • Fragile under anti-intellectual pressure

Raid Style

  • Pre-fight control

  • Information advantage

  • Roll manipulation

Play This If You Like

  • Outsmarting systems

  • Pattern recognition

  • Winning before action

Mal Says

“You’re not clever. You’re early.”

THE CHARIOT (SQUAD LEADER)

“Momentum is a decision.”

Core Identity

You turn individuals into coordinated force.

System Bias

  • Raid buff amplification

  • Morale stabilization

  • Tempo control

  • Coordination bonuses

Political Drift

  • Stable unless forced into injustice

Raid Style

  • Coordination-heavy

  • Buff stacking

  • Momentum control

Play This If You Like

  • Leading from the front

  • Team synergy

  • Tactical flow

Mal Says

“You are what happens when panic gets organized.”

STRENGTH (WARLORD)

“Power is applied, not declared.”

Core Identity

You impose outcomes through force and presence.

System Bias

  • Violence OP dominance

  • Massive morale swings

  • Accelerated Darkness risk

Political Drift

  • Pulls toward authoritarian extremes

Raid Style

  • Aggressive

  • High damage

  • Escalation-friendly

Play This If You Like

  • Big moves

  • Tactical dominance

  • Managing consequence

Mal Says

“You are correct. That does not mean you are right.”

THE LOVERS

“You choose. That is the power.”

Core Identity

You are defined by commitment and bond.

System Bias

  • Diplomacy & Unity synergy

  • Coalition bonuses

  • Relationship amplification

Political Drift

  • Stable in cooperation

  • Fractures under betrayal

Raid Style

  • Support synergy

  • Team amplification

  • Coalition strength

Play This If You Like

  • Loyalty

  • Shared outcomes

  • Emotional stakes

Mal Says

“You are strongest when you are not alone. That is also your weakness.”

TEMPERANCE

“Balance is active, not passive.”

Core Identity

You stabilize extremes and prevent collapse.

System Bias

  • OP efficiency

  • Overflow retention

  • Environmental resistance

Political Drift

  • Resists extremes

  • Strains under forced escalation

Raid Style

  • Sustain

  • Resource optimization

  • Damage control

Play This If You Like

  • Keeping things together

  • Playing the long game

  • Quiet dominance

Mal Says

“You don’t stop the fall. You make it survivable.”

THE HANGED MAN

“You understand cost.”

Core Identity

You gain power through sacrifice and inversion.

System Bias

  • Failure conversion

  • OP recovery

  • Strategic rebound

Political Drift

  • Stable under hardship

  • Breaks under meaningless loss

Raid Style

  • Risk acceptance

  • Recovery loops

  • Adaptive pressure

Play This If You Like

  • Sacrifice

  • Endurance

  • Turning loss into leverage

Mal Says

“You lose correctly.”

WHEEL OF FORTUNE

“You don’t control chaos. You ride it.”

Core Identity

You manipulate variance and outcome.

System Bias

  • Outcome shifting

  • Rerolls and choice control

  • Random table manipulation

Political Drift

  • Unstable but adaptable

Raid Style

  • High variance

  • Opportunistic

  • Swing-based

Play This If You Like

  • Chaos

  • Luck manipulation

  • Adaptive play

Mal Says

“You call it luck. I call it bias with better PR.”

DEATH (TRANSFORMER)

“You don’t destroy things. You end them properly.”

Core Identity

You are transition made manifest.
Where others cling, you release. Where others break, you complete.

System Bias

  • Strong transformation effects (state change mechanics)

  • Converts failure states into new opportunities

  • Accelerates system transitions (ownership, identity, control shifts)

  • Reduces cost of “ending” actions (retreat, collapse, dismantle)

Political Drift

  • Stable under revolutionary or reformist pressure

  • Generates high tension in static or preservation-focused factions

Raid Style

  • Surgical dismantling

  • Targeted elimination of systems rather than brute force

  • Clean endings, not messy fights

Play This If You Like

  • Change as power

  • Letting things end

  • Turning collapse into clarity

Mal Says

“You’re not killing it. You’re finishing it.”

THE DEVIL (EXPLOITER)

“Everything is a resource. Including people.”

Core Identity

You see leverage where others see limits.
You understand cost—and you’re willing to make others pay it.

System Bias

  • Strong Economy + Intrigue synergy

  • Converts corruption into advantage

  • Gains efficiency from exploitative systems

  • High OP generation potential under pressure

Political Drift

  • Pulls toward exploitative and authoritarian systems

  • Generates instability if unchecked

Raid Style

  • Asymmetric advantage

  • Exploiting weaknesses

  • Resource denial

Play This If You Like

  • Winning dirty

  • Leveraging systems

  • Power at a cost

Mal Says

“You didn’t break the rules. You just found the ones no one wanted to say out loud.”

JUDGEMENT (RECKONER)

“Everything comes due.”

Core Identity

You are consequence.
You do not act—you resolve.

System Bias

  • Strong Justice + Truth synergy

  • Punishes imbalance or corruption

  • Amplifies outcome severity

  • Increases impact of decisions already made

Political Drift

  • Stabilizes just systems

  • Destroys hypocritical ones

Raid Style

  • Punishment cycles

  • High consequence plays

  • Reaction-based dominance

Play This If You Like

  • Accountability

  • Moral clarity

  • Delivering consequences

Mal Says

“You’re not deciding. You’re confirming.”

JUSTICE (ARBITER)

“Fairness is a weapon.”

Core Identity

You enforce balance, not mercy.
You believe structure matters more than sentiment.

System Bias

  • Strong Nonlethal + Diplomacy synergy

  • Reduces variance in outcomes

  • Stabilizes roll results

  • Suppresses corruption

Political Drift

  • Stable under rule-based systems

  • Breaks under corruption or lawlessness

Raid Style

  • Controlled engagements

  • Low chaos

  • Precision outcomes

Play This If You Like

  • Fair systems

  • Clean decisions

  • Measured outcomes

Mal Says

“You think fairness is neutral. It never is.”

THE EMPRESS (CARETAKER)

“Growth is power.”

Core Identity

You create systems that nurture, expand, and sustain.

System Bias

  • Strong Culture + Mercy synergy

  • Boosts population growth and stability

  • Improves long-term resource generation

  • Strengthens Unity

Political Drift

  • Stable under cooperative systems

  • Struggles under exploitative regimes

Raid Style

  • Indirect

  • Support and sustain

  • Violence through resilience

Play This If You Like

  • Building instead of breaking

  • Growth over dominance

  • Long-term success

Mal Says

“You make things live. That’s harder than killing them.”

THE FOOL (CATALYST)

“You jump first.”

Core Identity

You initiate. You disrupt. You start things.

System Bias

  • Strong Freedom + Risk synergy

  • Increases variance

  • Enables new outcomes

  • Breaks established patterns

Political Drift

  • Unstable but dynamic

  • Drives rapid change

Raid Style

  • High-risk openings

  • Unpredictable plays

  • Momentum spikes

Play This If You Like

  • Chaos

  • New beginnings

  • Unpredictability

Mal Says

“You’re not reckless. You’re just early to the consequences.”

THE HERMIT (MYSTIC-ISOLATOR)

“You stepped away to see clearly.”

Core Identity

You gain clarity through distance.

System Bias

  • Strong Truth + Foresight synergy

  • Improves long-term prediction

  • Reduces noise and misinformation

  • Gains advantage in delayed decisions

Political Drift

  • Stable in isolation

  • Struggles in collective pressure

Raid Style

  • Slow, deliberate

  • Insight (Soul) (Soul)-driven

  • Precision timing

Play This If You Like

  • Solitude

  • Insight (Soul) (Soul)

  • Seeing patterns others miss

Mal Says

“You’re right. That doesn’t mean anyone will listen.”

THE HIGH PRIESTESS (SEER)

“You know before it happens.”

Core Identity

You perceive hidden truth and emerging patterns.

System Bias

  • Strong Foresight + Ritual synergy

  • Predictive advantages

  • Manipulates encounter outcomes

  • High information control

Political Drift

  • Stable under truth-aligned systems

  • Fragile under deception

Raid Style

  • Pre-emptive

  • Predictive

  • Control through knowledge

Play This If You Like

  • Seeing ahead

  • Hidden truths

  • Quiet control

Mal Says

“You don’t guess. You remember the future.”

THE STAR (HOPEBRINGER)

“Things can still get better.”

Core Identity

You generate hope under impossible conditions.

System Bias

  • Strong Mercy + Faith synergy

  • Restores morale

  • Reduces despair effects

  • Stabilizes Unity

Political Drift

  • Stabilizes collapsing systems

  • Struggles under extreme corruption

Raid Style

  • Recovery

  • Support

  • Turnarounds

Play This If You Like

  • Inspiring others

  • Holding the line

  • Refusing despair

Mal Says

“You’re either right… or the last one still trying.”

THE SUN (BEACON)

“You make things clear.”

Core Identity

You reveal truth and unify people around it.

System Bias

  • Strong Unity + Culture synergy

  • Improves coordination

  • Reduces confusion and deception

  • Enhances group effectiveness

Political Drift

  • Stable under open systems

  • Struggles under secrecy

Raid Style

  • Coordination

  • Clarity

  • High visibility

Play This If You Like

  • Leadership through presence

  • Making things obvious

  • Removing ambiguity

Mal Says

“You don’t illuminate. You expose.”

THE TOWER (BREAKER)

“It was going to fall anyway.”

Core Identity

You destroy unstable systems.

System Bias

  • Strong Violence + Truth synergy

  • High structural damage

  • Breaks entrenched systems

  • Accelerates collapse

Political Drift

  • Drives rapid change

  • Highly destabilizing

Raid Style

  • High damage

  • Structural targeting

  • Fast collapse

Play This If You Like

  • Breaking things

  • Forcing change

  • Ending false stability

Mal Says

“You didn’t cause the collapse. You just removed the delay.”

THE WORLD (INTEGRATOR)

“Everything connects.”

Core Identity

You unify systems into coherence.

System Bias

  • Strong Unity + Logistics synergy

  • Cross-system bonuses

  • Improves coordination at scale

  • Enables complex strategies

Political Drift

  • Stabilizes multi-system factions

  • Struggles under fragmentation

Raid Style

  • System-wide coordination

  • Strategic dominance

  • Big-picture control

Play This If You Like

  • Complexity

  • Integration

  • Seeing the whole board

Mal Says

“You understand everything. That means everything is now your problem.”

“You are not alone. You are infrastructure.”

What Crew Types Do

Crew Types describe the organizational culture your character emerged from.

They shape how you move through the world—not just what you can do, but how you solve problems under pressure.

They influence:

  • Raid Tendencies — how you behave in structured faction conflict
  • Strategic Bias — what your faction naturally excels at over time
  • Political Pressure — how your presence nudges faction ideology
  • Drift Vulnerability — how easily that ideology shifts under stress
  • Morale Patterns — how your group stabilizes… or fractures

Crew Types are subtle.

But they matter.

TERRAIN CREW TYPES

VERDANT STALKERS

“If the forest sees you, you’re already late.”

Core Identity

Recon specialists and ambush architects.
The terrain is not neutral—it is an accomplice.

System Bias

  • Dominates Forest / Jungle operations
  • Strong ambush and route concealment
  • Controls visibility and encounter outcomes
  • Converts terrain into tactical leverage

Political Drift

  • Leans decentralized and adaptive
  • Struggles under rigid hierarchy

Darkness Interaction

  • Low steady accumulation
  • Sharp spikes when secrecy collapses

Play This If You Like

  • Controlling the battlefield before it begins
  • Using terrain as a weapon
  • Being unseen but decisive

Mal Says

“The forest did not betray them. You did.”

ASHBOUND SURVIVORS

“You don’t conquer the wasteland. You outlast it.”

Core Identity

Hardship specialists. Survivors who turn suffering into leverage.

System Bias

  • Strong in Desert / Wasteland traversal
  • Converts hazards into recovery and value
  • Reduces attrition and failure impact
  • Turns bad terrain into viable infrastructure

Political Drift

  • Flexible, survival-first mindset
  • Can drift toward opportunism

Darkness Interaction

  • Slow accumulation
  • Can metabolize adversity into stability

Play This If You Like

  • Thriving in hostile environments
  • Turning loss into advantage
  • Winning by endurance

Mal Says

“You didn’t beat the wasteland. You made it useful.”

GRIDBREAKERS

“Everything broken still remembers how it worked.”

Core Identity

Urban salvagers and infrastructure hackers.
Dead cities are just sleeping systems.

System Bias

  • Dominates Ruins / Urban Wreckage
  • Strong salvage and material recovery
  • Reactivates dormant infrastructure
  • Converts ruins into economic engines

Political Drift

  • Leans pragmatic and utilitarian
  • Can drift toward exploitative systems

Darkness Interaction

  • Stable in controlled environments
  • Risk rises when pushing unstable systems too far

Play This If You Like

  • Rebuilding broken worlds
  • Extracting value from decay
  • Running the ruins instead of fearing them

Mal Says

“The city didn’t die. It was waiting for better management.”

IRONBOUND ASCENDANTS

“Height is not terrain. It is policy.”

Core Identity

Masters of elevation and positional warfare.
If you want it—you climb for it.

System Bias

  • Strong in Mountains / Highlands
  • Controls movement, chokepoints, and elevation
  • Defensive superiority from terrain
  • Predictable enemy pathing

Political Drift

  • Leans hierarchical and structured
  • Stable unless leadership fails

Darkness Interaction

  • Stable under pressure
  • Can harden into rigidity

Play This If You Like

  • Controlling space and movement
  • Defending from strength
  • Making enemies pay for every step

Mal Says

“Gravity is your ally. Use it.”

ABYSSAL CARTOGRAPHERS

“There are maps beneath the map.”

Core Identity

Explorers of hidden routes and submerged systems.
The world has layers. You walk all of them.

System Bias

  • Strong in Water / Cavern / Hidden Route traversal
  • Unlocks alternate paths and shortcuts
  • Enhances discovery and Spark-adjacent detection
  • Disrupts enemy predictability

Political Drift

  • Leans exploratory and curious
  • Can drift toward detachment from surface politics

Darkness Interaction

  • Attracted to deep anomalies
  • Exposure to strange routes carries risk

Play This If You Like

  • Finding paths no one else sees
  • Breaking map assumptions
  • Hunting hidden truths

Mal Says

“You didn’t get lost. You changed layers.”

STORM WARDENS

“Weather is only random if nobody is in charge.”

Core Identity

Environmental controllers and hazard governors.
Storms are not chaos. They are systems.

System Bias

  • Strong in hazardous terrain and weather events
  • Reduces environmental penalties and exposure
  • Can suppress or redirect hazards
  • Detects incoming environmental threats early

SEPHIROTIC ALIGNMENTS

“You are not neutral. You lean.”

Sephirotic Alignment represents:

  • Your connection to the underlying structure of reality (the forces that shape creation itself)

  • How your power expresses purpose

  • How you respond to Pressure (system stress that forces hard tradeoffs)

  • Your role in Raids (structured faction conflicts)

  • Your Political Drift (how faction ideology shifts under stress and action)

  • Your stability under Darkness (corruption pressure that builds as reality destabilizes)

The People Who Repair the World

In Bad Eden, every player controls a character—an individual living within the shattered fragments of reality.

Your character explores dangerous regions, uncovers hidden truths, confronts powerful threats, and helps guide the fate of the faction they belong to.

Where factions represent the collective power of communities, characters represent the choices and actions of individuals.

They are the explorers, negotiators, investigators, and heroes who step directly into the unknown.

Individuals Within a Greater Cause

Your character is not working alone.

Each character is a member of the faction your group controls, contributing their skills and perspective to the faction’s larger mission.

Characters might:

• explore newly discovered hexes
• negotiate with communities or rivals
• investigate strange phenomena
• confront hostile forces
• help guide faction decisions

Through these actions, characters shape both the immediate story of the campaign and the long-term future of the world.

Defining Your Character

Every character is defined by a set of character options that describe who they are and how they interact with the world.

These options may include things such as:

• ancestry and heritage
• archetype or role
• crew background
• philosophical outlook
• mystical or occult affiliations

Together, these choices determine your character’s abilities, worldview, and place within the setting.

Growth and Change

As the campaign progresses, characters evolve.

Through exploration, difficult decisions, and encounters with the strange forces shaping the world, your character may gain new abilities, insights, and responsibilities.

Over time, the experiences of the campaign will shape not only what your character can do, but who they become.

Characters and the Great Work

Every character participates in the effort to repair the broken world.

Sometimes that means confronting dangerous threats.
Sometimes it means helping communities rebuild.
Sometimes it means making difficult choices about the future.

However it happens, your character becomes one of the people helping move reality closer to harmony.

In Simple Terms

Characters are the human face of the story.

They explore the unknown, make difficult decisions, and carry the hopes of the faction into the world.

Through their actions, the future of the campaign unfolds.

PHILOSOPHY & CONSEQUENCES

“Your beliefs are not flavor. They are pressure.”

Every faction operates under a Political Philosophy.

That philosophy:

  • Defines what actions feel right

  • Determines what actions create Drift (ideological instability caused by contradiction)

  • Shapes how your faction responds to Violence, Unity (group alignment and coordination), Darkness (corruption pressure that builds as reality destabilizes), and survival

How It Works

👉 When your actions align with your philosophy:
Drift decreases (your faction stabilizes)

👉 When your actions contradict it:
Drift increases (pressure builds inside the system)

👉 When Drift gets too high:
Things break. Not abstractly. Systemically.

AUTHORITARIAN / STATIST

“Order above all.”

Core Belief

Stability comes from control, structure, and enforced coherence.

What Stabilizes You (Drift −)

Successful Violence (enforcement, suppression, decisive force)

Strong, maintained Unity

Suppression of dissent

What Destabilizes You (Drift +)

Peace-first approaches that weaken authority

Allowing dissent to spread

Failure to enforce order

Special Pressure

Minority dissent only reduces Drift if it is successfully suppressed

If dissent persists → Drift spikes rapidly

Play Pattern

Control systems

Enforce structure

Maintain authority at all costs

Mal Says

“You don’t need to be loved. You need to be obeyed.”

HOW TO USE THIS (PLAYER TOOL)

When deciding what to do, ask:

👉 “Would our philosophy approve of this?”

  • If yes → you stabilize

  • If no → you drift

  • If you ignore it → you fracture
